about_the_game:
Brutal combat. Open-world freedom. A world in mayhem.       

You awaken from a nightmare and Midgard is in chaos. Your simple way of life on your farm has been cut short and now you must fight to protect the ones you love, avenge the ones you lost and drive back the evil that plagues the lands of Midgard.

Every decision matters. Every swing costs stamina. Every mistake hurts. Leveling, skill unlocks, and stronger armor turn you from a vulnerable wanderer into a capable fighter ready for what Midgard throws at you.

Your path leads through a large open world filled with conflict, discovery, and challenges waiting across every stretch of land. A 30+ hour main story anchors your adventure, supported by side quests found across cities and villages throughout the world.

Travel wherever you choose. With the kingdoms of Midgard teetering on the brink of annihilation, the old gods are silent, and hordes of undead Draugr now claw their way out of the shadows. You are Midgard's last hope.

Unearth ancient ruins to discover the lore of the land and the dark secrets behind the Draugr plague spreading throughout Midgard!

  • Trade and Explore: Safe-haven cities and villages are your lifeline—places to save, trade, take quests, and regroup before heading back into the chaos beyond their walls.

  • Open-world survival: Explore wherever you choose. Travel across a massive open world and multiple realms with complete freedom to choose your path. 

  • Brutal combat RPG: Combat is fast and unforgiving. You'll need to level up and utilize skill points, as well as master timing and positioning to survive the dangers of Midgard. 

❤️ FROM A SOLO DEVELOPER

Tales of Eden Midgard is created by a solo developer dedicated to building a large open world, brutal action combat, and a long-form adventure shaped by passion and persistence. Your support, wishlists, and reviews truly help shape the future of Midgard. Thank you.

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: i5 3GHz or Ryzen 5 3GHz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1660 super
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 50 GB available space

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: i5 3GHz or Ryzen 5 3GHz

short_description: Midgard is a single-player, unforgiving, action-RPG with a handcrafted open world steeped in Norse mythology. Encounter intense combat and level up your character's skill sets to fight your way across the kingdoms of Midgard. Save the people from evil as you trade, craft, hunt and fish to survive!
